hero.lead: Corrugated shipping boxes, printed cartons, pizza and food packaging, display stands: made to your size and your brand.
hero.ch1.t: Every box starts as a flat sheet.
hero.ch1.p: On the die made to your size, cuts are marked in red and creases as dashed lines.
hero.ch2.p: Every crease is in the right place at the right depth; the box rises out of the sheet by itself.
hero.ch3.t: Your brand outside, your trust inside.
hero.ch3.p: The printed surface carries your brand, the corrugated structure protects your product.

fl.title: Strength hides inside the wave.
fl.sub: Corrugated board is a wavy paper between two flat liners. The size of the wave decides what the box can do.
fl.E.u: Thin, smooth surface; printed retail boxes and small packs.
fl.B.u: Balanced print and strength; light cartons and food boxes.
fl.C.u: High stacking strength; general-purpose shipping cartons.
fl.BC.u: Double-wall structure; heavy goods and export shipments.
pr.title: Six steps from sheet to shipment.
pr.1.d: Starting from your size, the box layout is drawn and the print file is prepared.
pr.1.c: Check: size, layout and print file approval.
pr.2.d: Board is made with the chosen flute and weight.
pr.3.d: Your brand colours are printed on the board or its coated surface.
pr.3.c: Check: colour match and print registration.
pr.4.d: The cutting die makes the cuts and the crease lines at once.
pr.4.c: Check: cutting depth and crease lines.
pr.5.d: Where needed the box is glued, folded flat and bundled.
pr.5.c: Check: glue strength and ease of opening.
pr.6.d: After size and print checks, your order is shipped.
pr.6.c: Check: quantity, labels and pallet layout.

about.title: About | Fortunepack
about.desc: Fortunepack makes corrugated packaging in Gaziantep so that products set off safely.
about.lead: Fortunepack makes corrugated packaging so that products set off safely.
about.s.p1: Every product leaves in a box. A well designed box keeps the product safe, makes the brand look stronger and makes shipping cheaper.
about.s.p2: At Fortunepack we do not just cut and fold corrugated board; we think about the weight of the product, the way it travels and the look of the brand together.
about.s.p3: From our facility in Gaziantep we supply made-to-measure packaging to food, e-commerce and industrial companies.
about.lb.title: Luck hides in the details.
about.lb.p: The ladybug in our logo is the sign of the Fortune name: we wish every shipment arrives smoothly and luckily, but we back luck with careful work.
about.v.title: Small measure, big difference.
about.v.1.d: We keep the size and the date we promise.
about.v.2.d: A millimetre decides what a box can do.
about.v.3.d: Corrugated board is recyclable; we suggest sizes that reduce unnecessary material.
about.v.4.d: You talk to the same team throughout the order.
about.q.title: Checked at every stage.
about.q.p: Size, print and glue quality are checked at every stage of production, and once more before shipment.

cs.folding.2d: The layout is drawn around your product size; empty space shrinks and material is saved.
cs.folding.3d: Colours and artwork are printed with surface and lamination options that fit your brand.
cs.shipping.2d: Flute and weight are chosen for the product weight and the pallet height.
cs.shipping.3d: Boxes are bundled flat, which lowers storage and transport cost.
cs.food.2d: We offer materials and coatings suited to surfaces that meet grease and moisture.
cs.food.3d: The print on the box turns the product into your brand at the moment of delivery.
cs.finishing.2d: The surface finish turns the box into an experience you can feel.
cs.finishing.3d: The finish is applied to selected areas such as a logo or pattern, keeping cost under control.
cs.special.2d: The box is planned around the shape of the product and where it is used.
cs.special.3d: Production starts after you approve the die and the print sample.
p.katlanir-karton.lead: Classic folding boxes that arrive as a flat sheet, set up easily and carry your brand.
p.katlanir-karton.s1t: Arrives flat, sets up in seconds
p.katlanir-karton.s1d: The box takes little room in storage; at the moment of use it sets up in one move and is ready to fill.
p.tek-nokta-yapistirmali.lead: A straight, economical box closed with a single side glue line that sets up quickly.
p.tek-nokta-yapistirmali.s1d: A single glue line speeds up production; a correctly die-cut box stands square when opened.
p.iki-nokta-yandan-yapistirmali.lead: A box glued from two side points, with reinforced side walls.
p.iki-nokta-yandan-yapistirmali.s1d: The second glue point locks the side wall; the box keeps its shape under load.
p.crash-lock-otomatik-taban.lead: A box whose base locks by itself when opened; ideal for fast packing lines.
p.crash-lock-otomatik-taban.s1d: Opening the box closes the base; packing time drops and manual work shrinks.
p.dort-kose-yapistirmali.lead: A sturdy box glued at four corners that sets up like a tray when opened.
p.dort-kose-yapistirmali.s1d: Glue at the corners gives a tall-sided box a rigid frame.
p.alti-nokta-yapistirmali.lead: A durable box glued at six points for tall and heavy products.
p.alti-nokta-yapistirmali.s1d: Six glue points spread the load across the walls; the box stays upright and neat.
p.sekiz-nokta-yapistirmali.lead: An eight-point glued box with very sturdy walls and a premium stance.
p.sekiz-nokta-yapistirmali.s1d: Every wall is fixed at several points; even heavy contents do not flex the box.
p.patates-kizartmasi-kutusu.lead: A serving box with a low front edge, designed for a grease-resistant surface and an easy grip.
p.patates-kizartmasi-kutusu.s1d: The low front gives easy access; venting helps the fries stay crisp.
p.yapistirmasiz-katlanir.lead: A one-piece box assembled with interlocking tabs, without any glue.
p.yapistirmasiz-katlanir.s1d: The tabs hold the box shut on their own; with no gluing stage, production is simpler.
p.slotter-kutular.lead: Four flaps, one piece: slotted boxes, the most common standard in shipping.
p.slotter-kutular.s1t: From a flat sheet, shipped flat
p.slotter-kutular.s1d: Boxes arrive flat and are set up and taped on site; many fit on a pallet.
p.teleskop-kutular.lead: Premium boxes where lid and body slide over each other with a rigid look.
p.teleskop-kutular.s1d: The lid fits the body snugly and makes the moment of opening special for gifts and product presentation.
p.pencereli-kutular.lead: Boxes with a clear window that shows the product, suited to food and gifts.
p.pencereli-kutular.s1d: The window film is bonded to the box; the customer sees the product without opening it, and trust builds by itself.
p.spot-uv-kutular.lead: Boxes with gloss varnish on selected areas, giving a contrast you can touch.
p.spot-uv-kutular.s1d: A glossy logo on a matte ground appears with the light; the box feels different in the hand.
p.sicak-yaldiz.lead: A premium surface with metallic foil stamped onto logos and details.
p.sicak-yaldiz.s1t: Metallic detail that shifts with light
p.sicak-yaldiz.s1d: Foil transfers under heat and pressure; logos and fine lines look sharp and bright.
p.sapli-tasima-kolileri.lead: A corrugated carton whose handle opening is die-cut, made for carrying by hand.
p.sapli-tasima-kolileri.s1d: The handle opening is placed relative to the centre of load; the carton stays balanced in the hand.
p.kraft-slotter.lead: Slotted boxes kraft inside and out, natural looking and recyclable.
p.kraft-slotter.s1d: The kraft surface gives a natural, honest impression; even a one-colour print shows the brand strongly.
p.pizza-kutulari.lead: Corrugated pizza boxes that hold the heat, manage steam and can be printed with your brand.
p.pizza-kutulari.s1t: Keeps heat in, lets steam out
p.pizza-kutulari.s1d: The corrugated structure holds heat and small vents release steam, keeping the pizza crisp.
p.acik-pencereli.lead: Open-window boxes that show the product directly, without film.
p.acik-pencereli.s1t: A direct look at the product
p.acik-pencereli.s1d: The window is die-cut; the product shows without film cost, and a single-material box makes recycling easier.
p.metalize-selefon.lead: Printed boxes with a bright metallic surface that catch attention in the window.
p.metalize-selefon.s1t: Catches the light in the window
p.metalize-selefon.s1d: Metallic film deepens the printed colours; the box stands out on shelves with its own brightness.
p.kozmetik-ilac.lead: Boxes for small and delicate products with sharp print and a clean, orderly look.
p.kozmetik-ilac.s1d: Fine text and small logos are printed sharply; the box is cut to sizes that fit the shelf layout exactly.
p.teshir-standi.lead: Foldable, light display stands that bring products forward at the point of sale.
p.teshir-standi.s1t: A stage at the point of sale
p.teshir-standi.s1d: Stepped shelves and a header card bring the product to eye level; the stand arrives flat and is set up in store.
p.eticaret-kutusu.lead: Boxes that open easily, wrap the product and suit postal shipping.
p.eticaret-kutusu.s1d: The inside of the lid can be printed too; the customer meets the brand the moment the box opens.
p.baskili-gida-kolisi.lead: Colourfully printed, stack-resistant corrugated cartons for food brands.
p.baskili-gida-kolisi.s1d: Product artwork and weight information print clearly on the carton, and it keeps its shape when stacked.
